title: Sorry, Sad or Afraid
goal: Say that you are sorry, sad or afraid about what others do with sentir, lamentar and temer.

sections.title: Unit 6, Lesson 2: Sorry, Sad or Afraid
body: In Lesson 1 the feeling was the subject of the verb (me molesta). In this lesson the person who feels is the subject: siento, lamentamos, temen.
You will practise sentir, lamentar and temer with que + subjunctive, the difference between sentir que 'to be sorry' and 'to feel that', and the way to offer sympathy.

items: I can say that I am sorry or afraid about what others do with siento que, lamento que and temo que.
I can tell sentir que 'to be sorry' from sentir que 'to feel that'.
I can use the new words for sympathy and fear.
